Table 10.8 China's Outward FDI Stock in Developed Countries ( Regions),by the end of 2017

By the end of 2017, China's outward FDI stock in transition economies had reached $27.49 billion, accounting for 1.5% of the total stock. In particular, Russia received $13.87 billion, accounting for 50.5% of the total stock in the transition economies.
